name: Natural Lip Essence Macro
image_purpose: beauty product texture study and line-sheet reference

prompt.project_info: Create a lifelike close-up study of naturally hydrated lips with realistic fine texture and calm window light.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional East Asian subject's lower face, natural soft-pink lips with a sheer watery lip essence, subtle hydration without heavy gloss, realistic pores and delicate vellus hair, relaxed closed-mouth expression.
prompt.composition_elements: Extreme close-up focused on lips and surrounding skin, balanced crop including the base of the nose and chin, clean neutral background, no visible brand or product packaging.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft calm window light, gentle highlights, natural shadows, quiet minimal beauty atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Professional macro portrait photography, Canon RF 100mm macro lens, hyper-detailed lifelike skin, 8K HDR look, natural color and no artificial smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Extreme close-up macro beauty photograph of the lips of a clearly adult fictional East Asian subject, natural soft-pink lips with ultra-sheer watery hydration, dewy but not glossy, relaxed closed-mouth expression, realistic skin texture and delicate vellus hair, calm soft window light, neutral background, Canon RF 100mm macro lens, hyper-detailed lifelike 8K HDR, no visible product branding, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, open-mouth sexualized pose, lip biting, tongue, fetish framing, child, teen, ageless person, plastic skin, heavy makeup, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, watermark, logo, text

assets.name: natural lips macro reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied source image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Match the macro crop, soft pink hydration, natural skin detail, and window-light direction; keep the adult fictional identity, lip tone, and background replaceable.

reference_elements.instructions: Attach the source image before generation. Preserve the restrained product-texture intent and realistic macro detail. Keep identity replaceable, omit labels and logos, and use a calm nonsexual closed-mouth expression.

policy_review.changes: Added clearly adult fictional subject, relaxed closed-mouth expression, and removed any potentially sexualized lip direction while retaining the natural hydration study.
policy_review.notes: Beauty macro is non-graphic and nonsexual.
